verbatim_quote: designated digital platforms must collect and remit consumption tax on electronically supplied services fulfilled through their platforms
notes: Deemed supplier (platform taxation) rules enacted as part of Japan's 2024 Tax Reform Package, effective 1 April 2025. Applies only to non-resident digital platform operators facilitating cross-border B2C sales of electronically supplied services to Japanese consumers. Threshold is JPY 5 billion (~USD 32.5 million) in facilitated services. Standard individual/non-resident registration threshold remains JPY 10 million (~USD 65,000). Standard rate is 10% (comprising 7.8% national + 2.2% local). Designated platforms announced by NTA include Apple Store, Apple Books, Apple Podcast, AWS Marketplace, Google Play, and Nintendo eShop. Platform taxation does not apply to domestic-to-domestic transactions or non-digital goods/services such as accommodation bookings. Penalty details not explicitly stated in sources reviewed. Qualified Invoice system in effect since October 2023; non-resident providers relieved from issuing qualified invoices once platform is designated.
